acip: DE LTA BU 'DIS CI BSTAN PA YIN ZHE NA, ZHI GNAS DANG LHAG MTHONG GOMS PAR BYAS PAS DNGOS PO'I MTHA' RTOGS PAR 'GYUR TE, DES SGRIB PA MTHA' DAG SPONG BA'I MTSAN NYID DGOS PA YONGS SU GRUB PA 'THOB BO,,
wylie: de lta bu 'dis ci bstan pa yin zhe na, zhi gnas dang lhag mthong goms par byas pas dngos po'i mtha' rtogs par 'gyur te, des sgrib pa mtha' dag spong ba'i mtshan nyid dgos pa yongs su grub pa 'thob bo
english: “And what is it,” you may ask, “that reveals these things to us?” It is when we engage in the practices of quietude and insight that we come to this realization of the ultimate end of things. It is these practices which enable us to reach the accomplishment of the final goal, characterized as it is by having eliminated each and every obstacle there is.
